operatorApproval.notes: Found while wiring X03-X05: the drift switch had to be affirmative-only because the spec demands intervention flags default OFF, and the pre-existing master switch broke that rule twice - PI_INFERENCE_RESILIENCE_ENABLED resolved to enabled=true with no environment at all, and its parser armed for any value that was not false/0/off, so a typo ('ture', '1x', even 'enabled') silently turned resilient retry, stream retry and model fallback on. The default is now false and the switch parses through the affirmative-only helper already used for the interactive fallback; overrides still arm it explicitly, and the other tunables keep their values because retryPolicy, resilientInference and resilientInstall all gate on cfg.enabled first. Verified 650/650 at this commit against 644/644 at the pre-series base 900bf8a3 over the inference/resilience/gateway/aps suites, zero failures either side. | CHAIN CORRECTION: this record supersedes X06/out/X06.handoff.json (sha256 kept immutable in out/), whose nextBaseSha pointed at the task commit 141ca5dbba11 while the next unit is cut from the evidence commit c179489e5ea3 that carries this unit's record; code, proofs and scope are unchanged.
